title: UAV State Estimation and Trajectory Prediction using Transformer-based Neural Networks and Feature-based Visual Odometry
authors: Y. Grigoriou; N. Souli; P. Chrysanthou; P. Kolios; G. Ellinas
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
